stem: An analyst reports a 95% confidence interval for the difference between two variants. What does the 95% describe?

options.text: About 95% of the users in the test had an individual lift inside the interval
About 95% of future tests of the same change will show a lift inside this interval
Over many repeats, about 95% of intervals built this way hold the true difference
The test had a 95% chance of detecting a true effect, which is its power
